questions.question: What is the primary purpose of applying a stain-resistant finish to textile fabrics? a). To prevent liquids and dirt from penetrating the fabric b). To improve fabric colorfastness c). To enhance thermal insulation d). To increase fabric weight / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• What is the primary purpose of applying a stain-resistant finish to textile fabrics?
  • a) To prevent liquids and dirt from penetrating the fabric
  • b) To improve fabric colorfastness
  • c) To enhance thermal insulation
  • d) To increase fabric weight
  • Answer: a) To prevent liquids and dirt from penetrating the fabric

questions.question: How does a water repellent finish differ from a waterproof finish? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• How does a water repellent finish differ from a waterproof finish?
  • Answer: A water repellent finish allows water to penetrate the fabric but resists wetting, whereas
  • a waterproof finish completely prevents water from passing through the fabric.

questions.question: Discuss at least three advantages of napping and explain how they improve the performance or appeal of fabric. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss at least three advantages of napping and explain how they improve the
  • performance or appeal of fabric.

  • fabric's ability to retain warmth and provides a plush texture.

questions.question: Discuss the advantages, limitations, and applications of disperse dyes. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the advantages, limitations, and applications of disperse dyes.
  • Answer: Disperse dyes are used for dyeing synthetic fibers like polyester. Advantages include
  • good colorfastness and a wide range of colors. Limitations include difficulty in achieving deep
  • shades and potential environmental concerns. Applications include dyeing polyester fabrics.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of package dyeing? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• What are the advantages and disadvantages of package dyeing?
  • Answer: Advantages of package dyeing include efficient use of dye and uniform coloration.
  • Disadvantages include potential for uneven dyeing if packages are not properly wound and the
  • need for careful control of dyeing conditions.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the process of duplex printing. / [CO4] [5x2 = 10]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the process of duplex printing.
  • Answer: Duplex printing involves printing designs on both sides of a fabric simultaneously using
  • two rollers, one for each side. This process allows for intricate designs on both sides of the
  • fabric with good registration.
